category_title: At-risk students balancing full-time employment and parental responsibilities
scenario_title: Academic self-doubt while balancing external life stressors
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete a reading assignment during a short four-hour school session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your assignment and finish the reading questions for today's class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I didn't get to finish it before school. I had to work my full-time job yesterday and then take care of my child all night.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to read it now and answer what you can.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm trying, but it's really hard to joggle among work, family responsibilities, and school. Sometimes when I doubt myself, I just feel like I can't catch up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep working on the questions on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't even concentrate on this right now. I doubt I'm going to pass anyway, so I'm just going to pack up and leave early today.

task.content: General academic pursuit while facing significant external life stressors (poverty, parenthood, violence).

context.social_setting: Teachers are able to reach out to everyone in the class unlike regular school

related_quotes: My teachers always have something good to say; sometimes when I doubt myself they encourage me and tell me positive things.

behavior_patterns.condition: As they joggle among work, family responsibilities, and school
